about: Found by the listed searches; not a census of the record, and no share of its rows is a rate over the record. Searches: (1) a read-only SQL query over the tracker's measured objects (research/tracking.db, table objects, 591 rows) for the words weight, uniform, probab, chance, equally, score, correlation, CHSH, fair, expect, entropy, marginal, bias, rate, share and "%" in the object, population or outcome: 281 hits; (2) the three track.py objects searches of the pre-registration. Hits examined: all 281 classified by a read-only helper (27 grown or with births as settings, 13 static, 110 weighting of patterns, starts or histories with a structure-level reading, 43 support only, 44 squared amplitudes or signs, 44 unrelated), the classification spot-checked by the drafter on nine rows; kept: the 27 and the rows their records add. Directories swept: the records (research/, proofs/, experiments/, artifacts/) of the setting line (REVIEW-LEADS-20261123-001C, THIRD-HOLDER-20261123-001A and B, ONE-PARENT-REREAD-20261123-001A, REREAD-BIRTHS-AND-MIXED-LAWS-20261123-001B and C, SETTING-AS-REREAD-20261123-001A) read in full; other records only at the lines cited. Not swept: records with no tracker object, the guide beyond the rows named, docs/. The guide rows are hand-picked (lessons 7.3, 8.4, 9.1 and the glossary entry for the disagreement rate), not swept. Kinds added on purpose: rows that agree under both countings, negative statements and a search winner, rates with no weighting word, and the ceiling at ratio 1.
